resources.string: The account and history remain viewable and are excluded from active totals. Internal transfer series become external series on the other active account, keeping their active or paused state. Series owned only by this account are paused. Unarchiving never re-links entries or recreates a series.

Counterparts become external entries. The account, opening balance and its entries are erased; other accounts’ entries and balances remain unchanged. Transfer series continue as external series on the surviving active account if previously active. Other series are stopped. This is permanent; existing backups remain available.
%1$d entry/entries erased; %2$d counterpart(s) kept; %3$d series affected.
The vault must retain at least one account. Archive the last account or create another one before deleting it.
Swipe left to archive, right to delete. Confirmation is always required.
